blocks.note: mesolve(H0) / mesolve(H0 + cos(omega t) H1) with c_ops sqrt(rate) L; exp(t liouvillian) on E_ij

chain.note: label basis; qutip mesolve in the full 2^L space; max_off_sector = largest entry of rho(t) between different particle-number sectors

channel_jump.note: label basis; qutip mesolve with c_ops sqrt(rate) K_0, sqrt(rate) K_1 (Kraus operators of amplitude damping with probability gamma on one site)
